notes.title: Another year, another halloween... and some added features
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It's that time of the year again. Halloween is upon us and our zombies are becoming unrestul. Well, they're always unrestful I guess :-) We opened our scavenger hunt back up again for those who missed their chance last year. Happy hunting.

We also added two often requested features into the game:
[list]
    [*]You are now able to create your own fertilizer through the new compost object
    [*]The sprinklers and turrets now show you a preview of the area they affect
[/list] 
We hope you like these additions. Especially the compost really expands upon the endless game mode :-)

Have a great halloween everyone
Anny and Oliver
